name: codebase-design
title_zh: 模块接口先看深度不看长度的设计内参
tagline_zh: 改接口前先问一句：这个模块是深是浅？用共享词汇把接缝、测试点和 AI 导航路径一次说清，省掉反复返工的讨论。
tagline_en: Before refactoring an interface, ask: is this module deep or shallow? Use shared terms to align seams.
desc_en: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
why_zh: 它给团队一套能指认「深模块」的共享词，让接口设计从各说各话变成可对齐的讨论，接缝该切在哪、哪里能挖深。
why_en: Gives your team a precise language for 'deep modules,' turning interface debates into alignable discussions—where seams go and.
limit_zh: 只提供设计词汇与判断框架，不生成代码、不画架构图、不检查具体实现；需要你已有模块代码或接口草案，且团队愿意用这套词对话。
limit_en: Vocabulary and judgment only—no code, diagrams, or implementation checks. Needs existing module code or an interface draft, plus a team willing to.
title_en: A shared vocabulary for designing deep module interfaces
